title: Rebuild the Bridge
can_do: 注意到自己的动作影响同伴后道歉，并提出能修复游戏的行动。

conversation_move.label: apologize and repair the shared activity

trigger: The child's truck accidentally bumps down a bridge the peer wanted to keep.
stretch_response: Can I help rebuild it with you?
repair_response: I did not mean to bump it. I can help fix it.
setting: Two children playing with a block bridge.
essential_props: a block bridge and toy truck

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: My bridge fell when your truck bumped it.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: I'm okay, but I wanted the bridge to stay up.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can I help rebuild it with you?

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Yes. Please hold this side while I add the top.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I will hold it. Let's try again together.

replay_cards.title: Fix the drawing
replay_cards.setting: Two children sharing a large paper
replay_cards.change: One child draws across the peer's road by mistake
replay_cards.challenge: Notice the effect, apologize, ask how to repair it, and add a useful bridge together

replay_cards.title: Return the moved piece
replay_cards.change: The child takes the piece the peer was about to place
replay_cards.challenge: Apologize, return the piece, and offer to find a different one

parent_support: Do not force an empty apology; make the impact visible and allow a repair action.
The peer can name what mattered, then accept a reasonable repair without instant praise.
